QuestInfo.name: Master of Mining 1
QuestInfo.0: Go to Grant to learn how to master Mining.
QuestInfo.1: Obtain the rare #b#t4007003##k from refining, and take it to Grant.
QuestInfo.2: Go see Grant again once you reach Mining Lv. 6.

0.0: I've called you here to help you fully master Mining. However, you need to prove your determination first. I want you to bring me a #b#t4007003##k.
0.1: This should be easy if you've been practicing. How about it?

yes.0: #b#t4007003##k can be obtained by refining #r#t4010002##k, #r#t4004002##k, or  #r#t4020003##k. Since they are rather rare, it will require some patience. I wish you luck.

no.0: Sure, come back whenever. We have all the time in the world, after all.

default.0: I don't think you have everything I asked you to get. Come back when you have everything.
